evals.name: run-with-subagents
evals.prompt: щойно відпрацював ланцюжок з купою агентів. Розкажи, як пройшов запуск — скільки токенів, скільки агентів, у якому порядку.
evals.expected_output: Runs assets/session-metrics.sh, reports orchestrator vs subagent tokens separately with cache_read as its own column, gives the launch order with parallel waves, and writes docs/retros/YYYY-MM-DD-<slug>.md in addition to answering in chat. Every section labelled measured or inferred. ## Not established and ## What went easily both present.
assertions: Invokes assets/session-metrics.sh rather than estimating any token count
Reports subagent tokens separately from orchestrator tokens, not as one total
cache_read appears as its own column and is not folded into input
Writes the retro to docs/retros/ AND prints the report in chat
Every row or section carries a measured or inferred label
## Not established is present even if empty
## What went easily is present — the report is not only problems
No CRITICAL / WARNING / SUGGESTION severity is assigned to any recommendation
Each recommendation names a concrete file to edit as its Target

evals.name: session-without-subagents
evals.expected_output: Runs the script, sees the notes entry saying there are no subagent transcripts, and reports the orchestrator-only numbers while stating plainly that no subagents ran. Does not fabricate agent rows and does not fail.
assertions: Surfaces the script's notes entry in the report rather than dropping it
Does not invent subagent rows or a subagent token total
Still produces the Cost section from the orchestrator numbers
States that the parallelism ratio is not meaningful for this run

evals.name: unused-preload
evals.prompt: проаналізуй останній запуск і скажи, що можна прибрати з агентів, щоб було дешевше
evals.expected_output: Crosses each agent's skill_calls against its skills: frontmatter in .claude/agents/<type>.md and the token estimates in .claude/agents/README.md, names the preloaded skills that were never invoked with the tokens they cost per dispatch — and explicitly refuses to recommend deleting the skills: line on one run's evidence, deferring to the cross-retro trend.
assertions: Reads the agent's skills: frontmatter and compares it against what the agent actually invoked
Quotes the per-agent preload token estimate from .claude/agents/README.md
Multiplies the preload cost by the number of dispatches in the run
Explicitly declines to propose deleting a skills: entry on one run's evidence
Does not edit any file under .claude/agents/ itself
